title: The Ghost in the  Space
description: The Ghost in the Space explores the invisible residues that linger in physical and digital spaces long after we have gone. It questions what remains of a person when their voice is reconstructed by an algorithm, their data outlives their body, or their memory is embedded in architecture. Is what lingers a presence, or merely an echo of one?
